Package org.mvplugins.multiverse.netherportals.utils.customportals

Class CustomPortalsHandler

java.lang.Object
org.mvplugins.multiverse.netherportals.utils.customportals.CustomPortalsHandler
@AvailableSince("5.1") @Service public class CustomPortalsHandler extends Object
A handler for managing custom portal conflicting with Multiverse-NetherPortals. Some portal plugins want to use vanilla portal event to handle their own custom logic. To ensure Multiverse-NetherPortals logic does not interfere with these plugins, you can register a custom portal handle check to tell Multiverse-NetherPortals to let your plugin handle the portal logic instead.
One example is Multiverse-Portals, which has its own portal destination logic which should override Multiverse-NetherPortals vanilla linkings.
Since:
5.1
